notes: The 3D viewer now writes a line before and after every native call inside the model load, so the next log from the phone names the exact call the process dies in
The two calls that could throw on the render thread without a catch (flushAndWait, addEntities) are now wrapped, so a Java-level failure leaves a line where it used to kill the process silently
No customer-visible changes — this build exists to name the P30 Pro's dying call
